- A/B差距从pair-only的10.14476，到≤3的5.11084、≤4的3.41750，最终为 **3.04640085**；高阶集体连接大幅削弱差距，但没有翻转。

[PR484](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/pull/484) 已追加新数据[3e01b49](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/3e01b495b5b637b0070705e37b4137a9a0ef0d8b)和分析[b892d9e6](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/b892d9e6)。三形状各800万counter、400batch；24M geometry-pair evaluations，但只有一个8M共享counter依赖块，与N100独立。所有period×2，本机三进程363–429秒完成。

## 2026-08-31 上下文恢复（原提案保留在下）

- 精确有理例子、模型关系/协方差子空间/有限 gauge 与 compiler 等支持片段已经完成；PR #424/#428 及 #456–#461 的结果不能再合并描述为一个待建工具包。
- **已接触真实生产。** [`f5779b91`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/f5779b91)（branch_only，analysis/p370-production-confidence-etop-20260830）把八个100M/500M级 A_top/E_top 行接入有理外置信集证书：E=0、E=−A、E=A 被排除；自由共同射线仍有 witness r=−2/3。
- 精确的是给定外置信集与模型方程的代数排除，不是已证明有限样本覆盖，也不是对所有物理 M1/M2d/M2j 的完整认证。完整 gauge atlas、一般不等式/SOS 等仍开放，但不作为现有数据分析的许可条件。
- 现阶段支持具体科学问题：使用已完成的 norm-4/norm-5 和 factorial 结果定位仍存机制；优先推进能改变该比较答案的证书扩展，避免把 synthetic/compiler/validator 再列成独立先修任务。
- 已补读 2026-08-31 新认领的六项 interval/parameter-box/ideal/SOS/gauge/compiler 扩展：它们目前是工具支持任务，不是新的生产结论。允许并行，优先服务明确的物理模型比较，不成为 E_top 或其他现有数据分析的先修条件。
- 当前总览与下一步见 Draft #267 的[上下文恢复](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md)与[注意力顺序](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/NEXT-TARGETS.md)；原提案全文保留在下。

---

## Trigger

Matching One now has several unusually strong but still mostly **fit-based** structural programs:

- #249 asks for the minimal context-Hankel realization of the Gaussian-cover category;
- #218 asks whether a Jordan block emerges through eigenvalue/eigenvector coalescence;
- #233 constrains a possible matching defect by pull-through and fusion relations;
- #244 supplies exact character-selection zeros;
- #258/#262/#263 constrain the full `Q -> 1` tangent through measure, projector, field and crossing data;
- #265 asks the project to stop multiplying interpretations and maximize the rate at which live mechanisms become mutually impossible.

These programs can all produce residuals, likelihoods, singular-value gates or held-out scores. They do not yet provide a common answer to the stronger question:

> **Can we certify that no realization in a declared low-rank/algebraic model class is compatible with the typed evidence and its uncertainty, independent of optimizer initialization, latent gauge and local minima?**

I propose a proof-carrying model-elimination layer based on polynomial optimization and sum-of-squares / moment relaxations.

This is **not a new physical mechanism**. It is a compiler from existing mechanism claims to machine-checkable no-go certificates.

## Paradigm shift: from best fit to certified disjointness

Let

```text
y in R^m
```

be one typed vector of observed contexts/readouts with covariance `Sigma`, dependency-group identity, chronology and exact semantic descriptors. Let a named model class `M` predict

```text
F_M(theta) in R^m
```

where `theta` contains a fixed-dimensional realization, source/readout vectors and any declared amplitudes.

For a predeclared confidence region in the identifiable covariance subspace,

```text
Y_alpha = {
  z : (z-y)^T Sigma^+ (z-y) <= c_alpha,
      z-y lies in range(Sigma)
},
```

the scientific question is the feasibility problem

```text
exists theta in Theta_M such that F_M(theta) in Y_alpha ?
```

Equivalently define the globally minimized discrepancy

```text
delta_M^2 = inf_(theta in Theta_M)
            (y-F_M(theta))^T Sigma^+ (y-F_M(theta)).
```

A local optimizer returning a large residual is not a no-go result. A rigorous lower bound

```text
lower_bound(delta_M^2) > c_alpha
```

or an explicit Positivstellensatz/SOS infeasibility identity is.

The certificate should be stored with the model descriptor, input artifact hashes, covariance convention and a verifier. This makes a mechanism exclusion portable across refactors and independent of the fitting implementation.

## Why the current model classes are algebraic enough

After fixing the predictive dimension `r`, split complex quantities into real and imaginary parts and represent the latent generators by ordinary matrix-entry variables. The model predictions

```text
f_(ell,rho)(w) = c_ell^T A_w b_rho
```

are polynomial in those entries for every finite word `w`.

The live structural hypotheses already impose polynomial equalities or inequalities.

### Product-only realization

```text
A_a A_b - A_b A_a = 0
A_(a^2) - A_a^2 = 0
A_(ab)  - A_a A_b = 0
A_gbar C - C A_g = 0
```

with a declared conjugation/intertwiner convention.

### Rank-2 Jordan transfer

After removing the known leading character, one convenient fixed-cocycle form is

```text
A_m = I + lambda_m K
K^2 = 0
rank(K) = 1
lambda_m = log Norm(m)
```

or a more general generic-`Q` derivative law with fixed `lambda_m`. The constants `log 2`, `log 5`, etc. can enter through certified rational intervals; they are not fitted separately per context.

### Ordinary diagonalizable/multi-field realization

Use characteristic/minimal-polynomial constraints, a declared spectral-separation condition when needed, and the same generators across every context. Do not encode “diagonalizable” by numerically diagonalizing each fitted matrix after the fact.

### Defect/fusion realization

The pull-through, fusion, projector and seam-translation relations of #233 are polynomial matrix identities once a bounded bond dimension and local tensor support are fixed.

### `Q -> 1` tangent realization

The measure, projector, field and crossing derivatives in #258/#262/#263 supply linear or polynomial relations among the tangent blocks and residues. Exact selection zeros from #244 and representation exclusions become hard constraints rather than soft penalty terms.

### Cover-enriched realization

Deck/Smith projectors, idempotents and character intertwiners are finite algebraic data. A rank-3 cover-memory model can therefore be tested as a distinct semialgebraic class rather than an unconstrained extra latent coordinate.

For fixed `r`, a commutative SOS hierarchy over matrix entries is sufficient. A dimension-free operator formulation may later use a noncommutative moment hierarchy, but the first implementation should not impose a positive Hilbert-space Gram structure on signed response data unless that positivity has actually been derived.

## Similarity gauge must be fixed before certification

A raw realization has the gauge

```text
A_g -> S A_g S^-1
b   -> S b
c^T -> c^T S^-1.
```

This creates noncompact flat directions and can make polynomial optimization meaningless. The manifest must declare one of the following exact gauges:

1. **reachable-source gauge:** choose `r` frozen source columns whose controllability minor is bounded away from zero and set the corresponding source matrix to the identity;
2. **observable-readout gauge:** the dual construction using a frozen readout minor;
3. **Hankel-minor gauge:** anchor one completed rank-revealing context minor and fix its factorization convention;
4. **invariant-coordinate formulation:** for very small `r`, optimize directly over traces, determinants, minimal-polynomial coefficients and observable contractions.

The certificate is valid only on the stated gauge chart. If several charts are needed to cover the admissible model class, certify every chart or retain an explicit uncovered set.

## Two certificate levels

### Level E — exact finite-volume certificate

Use exact enumeration or symbolic transfer matrices at tiny width/size.

Inputs may be rational functions of `Q`, loop weight or `p`; after specialization, all constraints are exact rational/algebraic equalities. The desired output is one of:

```text
exact feasible realization,
exact rank lower bound,
exact polynomial infeasibility certificate,
precise undecided result at the chosen relaxation order.
```

This level is the positive control and should be independently verified by rational or interval arithmetic.

### Level S — statistical robust certificate

For Monte Carlo-derived rows, certify disjointness between the model image and a **predeclared outer confidence set** for the true mean vector.

Requirements:

- build `y` and `Sigma` inside the existing aligned-batch/delete-one semantics;
- keep singular covariance directions explicit;
- calibrate `c_alpha` by the repository's frozen bootstrap/null procedure or use a conservative finite-sample bound;
- rationally/interval-enclose the confidence set and all fixed irrational constants used by the model;
- verify the final dual/SOS certificate with numerical residual bounds or exact rational reconstruction;
- report “not certified” rather than “accepted” when the relaxation is inconclusive.

A numerical SDP optimum alone is not a proof.

## First model ladder

Start with a deliberately small ladder already implicit in #249:

```text
M1   rank-1 scalar character
M2d  rank-2 product-only diagonalizable realization
M2j  rank-2 common-nilpotent Jordan realization
M2g  rank-2 constrained two-generator model from #200
M3c  rank-3 cover/deck/Smith-enriched realization
```

Each class must include:

```text
state dimension,
source/readout descriptors,
word/order convention,
all algebraic relations,
gauge chart,
parameter bounds and their provenance,
allowed exact zeros,
chronology/evidence block,
confidence-set construction,
certificate order and verifier.
```

Do not certify against a straw-man implementation of a mechanism. For example, `M2j` must use one shared nilpotent/cocycle law across every multiplier, not independent `A+B log N` coefficients for each scalar row.

## No-new-production proof of concept

### A. Synthetic exact oracles

Construct exact rational examples where:

1. `M1` is impossible and `M2d` is feasible;
2. `M2d` is impossible and `M2j` is feasible;
3. endpoint contexts are compatible with `M2j`, but one morphism-sensitive context forces `M3c`;
4. the data lie near a gauge-chart boundary;
5. a deliberately inconsistent exact-zero row is caught immediately.

The hierarchy must recover an explicit realization when a flat-extension/extraction condition holds and an independently verified certificate when the class is impossible.

### B. Existing exact/tiny-width data

Use the smallest exact Gaussian-cover or transfer-matrix contexts already present in the repository. Certify at least one known rank/algebra relation before touching the large Monte Carlo blocks.

The new noncrossing state codec in PR #364 is a natural source of exact small-width transfer data once transitions exist.

### C. Existing context-Hankel rows

Apply the first statistical certificate only to a tiny, frozen vector such as

```text
P4[D], P4[D'], P4[S']
under norm-2 and norm-5 contexts,
```

or to the completed norm-4 `q=2` versus Jordan residual block. Begin with `M1`, whose global optimum should be independently checkable. Expand to `M2d/M2j` only after the gauge and covariance treatment pass exact/synthetic tests.

### D. Exact selection-rule injection

Add #244's forbidden global first-order deck-character response as a hard equality. A fake nonzero charged column must make every relevant model infeasible. This checks that semantic zeros participate in the certificate rather than being rediscovered as small fitted coefficients.

## Dual certificates should guide the next measurement

The dual SOS multipliers identify which observed equations and inequalities create the contradiction. This gives a new acquisition rule complementary to #102's expected KL/CPU and #249's rank-revealing minor:

> choose the cheapest missing context whose admissible range most increases the certified separation margin between the surviving model classes.

Concretely, for every candidate unrevealed row `j`:

1. retain it as a symbolic interval variable;
2. compute the interval over which the current class remains feasible;
3. combine that separating interval with the candidate's predicted variance/cost;
4. rank by expected probability of crossing the **certificate boundary** per CPU-second.

A candidate can be valuable even when it adds little Fisher information if it closes one algebraic loophole. Conversely, many more samples on an already redundant row may barely move the certificate margin.

The stored dual certificate should also expose whether an exclusion is driven by one fragile row, a chronology-reused block or a broad set of independent algebra relations.

## Expected scientific outcomes

### `M1` certified impossible, `M2d` feasible

The scalar correction picture is eliminated globally; the smallest surviving state is ordinary rank 2.

### `M2d` certified impossible, `M2j` feasible

This is stronger than a better Jordan fit, but still not a field identification. It says the declared product-only contexts require a common nonsemisimple law within the tested class.

### Both `M2d` and `M2j` certified impossible, `M3c` feasible

The extra state is tied to cover/deck/Smith memory in the declared realization. Do not name it as a new bulk primary without an independent continuum fingerprint.

### All bounded low-rank classes certified impossible

Stop enlarging a small transfer matrix one field at a time. The current observable family has no realization in the tested algebraic envelope; move toward broader spatial/process descriptions such as #256/#227.

### No class can be certified either way

This is an experimental-design result. Report the exact unclosed gauge chart or missing context and acquire the row that most shrinks it.

## Relation to existing issues

- **#249:** supplies the context-Hankel state and model ladder; this issue adds globally valid exclusion certificates rather than replacing Ho--Kalman/rank estimation.
- **#102/#254:** supplies information-per-CPU design; certificate sensitivity adds algebraic loophole closure as another utility.
- **#218:** emerging-Jordan diagnostics remain necessary for physical interpretation after a Jordan algebraic class survives.
- **#233:** defect pull-through/fusion relations become certifiable constraints under a fixed locality/bond-dimension cap.
- **#244:** exact selection zeros become hard equalities.
- **#258/#262/#263:** the complete `Q` tangent/crossing system supplies a much more restrictive polynomial class than a scalar Q-score.
- **#265:** this is explicitly an interpretation-killing layer, not another interpretation stack.

## Deliverables

```text
notes/proof-carrying-model-elimination.md
analysis/algebraic_model_certificate_manifest.yaml
scripts/build_algebraic_model_problem.py
scripts/solve_sos_model_certificate.py
scripts/verify_model_certificate.py
results/model-certificates/<model>/<snapshot>.json
```

Each result artifact should contain:

```text
immutable input artifact hashes,
typed row/context descriptors and dependency groups,
model equations and exact constants,
gauge charts and coverage statement,
confidence-set definition,
relaxation order and primal/dual bounds,
solver residuals,
rational/interval verification status,
extracted realization when available,
dual support over rows/constraints,
certificate-guided next-row ranking,
claim level: exact / robust-statistical / numerical-diagnostic / inconclusive.
```

## Acceptance / claim boundary

1. A local nonlinear fit, random-restart agreement or small residual is not a certificate.
2. A floating-point SDP result is not exact until independently verified.
3. Failure to certify infeasibility does not validate the model.
4. A certificate excludes only the fully declared model class, rank cap, gauge coverage, locality/bond-dimension cap and confidence set.
5. Statistical certificates remain one conclusion from the underlying dependency block; alternative coordinates do not become independent evidence.
6. Fixed bounds used to compactify the parameter space must have physical/algebraic provenance or be covered by an explicit exhaustion argument.
7. Do not assume positivity of a latent Gram form for signed observables unless it is derived from the model.
8. Physical field names require the independent transfer/modulus/OPE/charged/control fingerprints already demanded elsewhere in the repository.

## Literature anchors

- Pironio, Navascués, Acín, arXiv:0903.4368 — convergent moment/SOS relaxations for polynomial constraints in noncommuting operators, with optimizer extraction under a rank condition.
- Klep, Schweighofer, arXiv:1207.1691 — exact algebraic infeasibility/duality certificates for semidefinite systems.
- Nie, arXiv:1206.0319 — conditions for finite convergence of the commutative Lasserre hierarchy.
- Wang, Magron, arXiv:2010.06956 — term-sparse noncommutative SOS hierarchies, relevant if the dimension-free formulation becomes necessary.
- Zheng, Jedra, Proutière, arXiv:2506.08720 — rank-adaptive minimal-order recovery from noisy Hankel data; complementary estimation layer, not a global algebraic no-go certificate.

## Bottom line

The repository already has enough candidate mechanisms.

The next methodological breakthrough is to make them submit to a common standard:

```text
Either exhibit one realization satisfying every typed relation,
or produce a checkable certificate that no such realization exists.
```

That would turn Matching One from a sophisticated model-comparison project into a proof-carrying mechanism-elimination program.

- **已做成的是 canonical Phase D。** 十个跨几何方向对与六个 norm-4 块已实际分析（Draft #267：[`1df903e`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/1df903e)、[`ede8e62`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/ede8e62)）；norm-4 的 E_top=0 为 chi²=5324.015/6。这里 E_top=P2+P0=1−P1 是拓扑坐标，不是已标定的能量算符。

---

## Trigger

The repository's logical reorganization and the new digital-Alexander theorem change the continuum bridge qualitatively.

PR #270/#271 establish, for the honest periodic square-cell torus,

```text
r_black + r_white = 2,
q(omega) = r_black - 1
         = 1 - r_white
         = (r_black-r_white)/2.
```

Hence, if

```text
P_j = Prob(rank image[H1(black)->H1(T2)] = j),
```

then configuration by configuration / in expectation

```text
M_N(p) = E[q] = P_2 - P_0.
```

The rank-1 sector cancels **exactly**. The matching observable is therefore a canonical modular-scalar ambient-homology projector, not merely an empirical difference of two wrapping channels.

There is an equally sharp continuum fact that now becomes directly relevant.

Arguin, arXiv:hep-th/0111193, computes the FK torus partition functions restricted to homology subgroup. For the trivial subgroup and the full `Z x Z` / cross sector, his equations give

```text
Z_Q(cross) = Q * Z_Q(trivial).
```

Therefore the normalized continuum contrast satisfies

```text
pi_Q(cross)-pi_Q(trivial)
 = (Q-1) pi_Q(trivial),
```

and in particular

```text
boxed: pi_1(cross)-pi_1(trivial)=0
```

for critical percolation, at arbitrary torus modulus.

This suggests a paradigm shift:

> **The finite square-site matching signal is best viewed as the leading lattice discretization defect of a continuum homology identity that is exactly zero at Q=1.**

The continuum observable itself is not a nonzero one-point field. The physics lies in which irrelevant / logarithmic singlet operator first breaks the exact topological zero at finite lattice spacing.

## Immediate consequence for the x=17/4 competitor

Issue #262 places the lower four-leg spin-4 family `V_(2,+/-2)` in a nontrivial Potts `[2]` representation rather than the singlet. Issue #257 asks why this more relevant field (`x=17/4`) does not dominate the global matching signal.

The new homology formulation gives a concrete selection hypothesis:

```text
P_2-P_0 is an unlabelled S_Q-invariant torus projector,
therefore its ordinary one-point finite-size expansion contains only Potts-singlet states.
```

If this statement can be made exact in the analytically continued Potts/partition-algebra description, then

```text
< P_2-P_0 | V_(2,+/-2)_[2] > = 0
```

is not a small amplitude—it is a representation-theoretic zero.

That would remove the lower x=17/4 primary from the global channel and make the singlet thermal-Q4 descendant `x=21/4, spin=4` a much more natural leading candidate.

The local marked-pivotal/four-arm observable can still overlap the `[2]` sector once cluster labels / charged projectors are inserted, so this does not imply local and global H4 are the same operator.

## Phase A — make the homology contrast an explicit generic-Q projector

Use Arguin's restricted partition functions and the state-space/twisted-torus machinery of Jacobsen--Ribault--Saleur, arXiv:2208.14298.

Construct

```text
H_Q(tau)
 = Z_Q(cross;tau) - Z_Q(trivial;tau)
```

and its normalized version. Verify symbolically that

```text
H_Q = (Q-1) Z_Q(trivial)
```

in the continuum formulas, with the precise convention for FK rank-1 sectors and total normalization.

Then determine the global-symmetry representation carried by the operator/projector that measures this contrast. The desired output is an explicit singlet projector statement, not merely the observation that the scalar probability is color-blind.

## Phase B — turn the x=17/4 absence into an exact zero

Combine the homology projector with #262's generic-Q `[2]` projector.

Derive one of the following:

```text
P_singlet * P_[2] = 0
```

at the finite partition-algebra / twisted-state level, or an equivalent zero of the relevant torus matrix element / invariant tensor.

Track the Q->1 limit carefully: categorical dimensions can vanish and derivatives can survive. Distinguish

```text
ordinary overlap = 0,
Q-derivative/residue overlap != 0
```

if that occurs.

This is the exact selection rule requested by #257.

## Phase C — identify the first allowed spin-4 singlet defect

Once charged `[2]` fields are removed, classify the lowest Potts-singlet spin-4 corrections that can break the continuum zero.

The current live candidates include

```text
vacuum/KdV spin-4 sector, x≈4, where observable semantics permit it;
thermal Q4 descendant / inherited energy-hull Jordan pair, x=21/4;
derivative/confluent singlet fields generated at Q=1;
cover/topological/combinatorial-map singlet corrections.
```

Do not rank them by dimension alone. The homology projector supplies additional topology/modular selection.

Derive the torus one-point / restricted-sector response of each allowed singlet candidate. The ideal output is a vector over

```text
rank 0,
rank 1 primitive sectors,
rank 2
```

whose contraction with `( -1, 0, +1 )` gives the matching correction.

## Phase D — a canonical two-dimensional scalar rank basis

The exact rank probabilities have only two nontrivial scalar coordinates after normalization. Use

```text
A_top = P_2 - P_0,      # Alexander-odd contrast = matching
E_top = P_2 + P_0
      = 1 - P_1.        # Alexander-even non-rank1 probability
```

Under complement/Alexander duality

```text
P_0 <-> P_2,
P_1 -> P_1,
```

so `A_top` is odd and `E_top` is even.

This is a **canonical topology-defined 2D state**, not a target-learned PCA basis.

Before introducing an arbitrary second even bulk mode for the residual seen in the norm-4 reveal, test whether the missing finite-size direction is simply the `E_top` coordinate or its thermal derivative.

Use existing `cross/either` sufficient statistics if available:

```text
P_2 = P_cross,
P_0 = 1-P_either,
P_1 = P_either-P_cross.
```

Recompute the full covariance in every delete-one block. This is one correlated reanalysis, not new evidence.

## Phase E — reinterpret the norm-4 Jordan tension

PR #273 rejects the frozen analytic q=2 law strongly and leaves the rank-2 Jordan law just above the 5% boundary in both scalar and full thermal-jet scores.

Instead of immediately fitting `Jordan + arbitrary even mode`, compare the two structural alternatives:

```text
J_top:
  one Jordan generalized direction in A_top
  + the canonical E_top topology mode;

J_bulk:
  one Jordan generalized direction
  + a second ordinary singlet bulk field unrelated to homology rank.
```

If `E_top` absorbs the lineage-dependent residual with one common transfer law, the missing state is topological-sector redistribution rather than a new bulk primary.

If it does not, the residual has earned promotion to a genuinely new singlet mode.

## Phase F — connect to matching Q-derivative / tangent-CFT work

The exact continuum relation gives an unusually simple Q tangent:

```text
d/dQ [pi_Q(cross)-pi_Q(trivial)]_(Q=1)
 = pi_1(trivial).
```

This is a parameter-free topological tangent, separate from the lattice finite-spacing matching defect.

Use it as a calibration target for #114/#258/#263:

- #114: the generic-Q homology projector is now explicit;
- #258: the critical-manifold Q-score should reproduce this derivative after all field/projector terms are included;
- #263: the linearized Potts crossing must preserve the singlet/topological tensor structure of this tangent.

Do not conflate the Q tangent with the finite-a lattice defect; their relationship is itself a testable piece of the continuum bridge.

## Radical conjecture

My current strongest guess is:

> **Matching One is observing the leading irrelevant spin-4 violation of an exact continuum homological Ward identity.**

The identity is

```text
P_cross = P_trivial        at Q=1 criticality,
```

while the square-site discretization has

```text
P_cross-P_trivial != 0
```

at finite size. The leading violation is forced to be a modular-scalar, Potts-singlet lattice correction. This explains why a lower charged four-leg primary can exist in the CFT without appearing globally.

If the leading singlet violation is the thermal Q4 logarithmic module, the observed `x=21/4` and the new norm-4 Jordan result become two aspects of one statement: the lattice approaches the exact homological identity through an indecomposable singlet spin-4 correction.

## Falsification

- If the homology contrast is not a singlet projector in the generic-Q state-space construction, this selection explanation fails.
- If `[2]` has a nonzero ordinary matrix element in the unlabelled rank contrast, reopen x=17/4 globally.
- If the leading finite-size rank-sector vector is orthogonal to the Q4/Jordan torus response, Q4 is not the defect that restores the homology identity.
- If the canonical `E_top` mode does not explain the norm-4 residual, do not force it; then a second bulk/defect state is genuinely required.

## Literature anchors

- Arguin, arXiv:hep-th/0111193 — exact critical Potts/FK torus probabilities by homology subgroup and `Z_cross = Q Z_trivial`.
- Jacobsen--Ribault--Saleur, arXiv:2208.14298 — Potts state spaces, twisted torus partition functions and S_Q representation decomposition.
- Duncan--Schweinhart, arXiv:2207.08339 and arXiv:2406.08043 — homological duality/random-cluster structures on tori.
- Nivesvivat, arXiv:2205.09349 — Potts invariant tensors and representation-resolved crossing.
- He, arXiv:2411.18696 — c=0 singlet logarithmic multiplets.

Related: #54, #61, #114, #156, #220, #257, #258, #262, #263, #269, PR #271, PR #273.

## New opportunity

PR #149 makes the noncyclic norm-4 descendants production-capable:

```text
65 -> 130 -> 260
85 -> 170 -> 340
```

The second step closes the exact Gaussian semigroup relation

```text
(1+i)^2 = 2i,  Norm=4.
```

Norm 4 is not competitive with norm 5 for the primary H4-vs-H12 angular question, but it is unusually clean for the **S-prime q=2 versus rank-2 Jordan** problem because it gives equally spaced steps in `log N` and needs smaller children than N325/N425.

This issue must not delay or alter Issue #57. Treat it as a specialized secondary discriminator enabled by the new general-period backend.

## Observable

Use the intrinsic-coordinate thermal readout already defined in PR #142:

```text
U(N) = N^(13/8) * P4[S_prime](N) / MbarPrime(N).
```

The two live discovery-level structures are

```text
ordinary q=2: U(N) = A + C/N
rank-2 Jordan: U(N) = A + B log N.
```

All centers, slopes and projectors must be recomputed inside each delete-one batch replicate.

## Exact dyadic identities

For one parent triple `(N,2N,4N)` define increments

```text
d1 = U(2N)-U(N)
d2 = U(4N)-U(2N).
```

Then

```text
q=2 ordinary: d2/d1 = 1/2
rank-2 Jordan: d2/d1 = 1
```

Do not use the literal ratio as the primary statistic. Use the two linear null residuals:

### ordinary-null

```text
R_q2(N) = U(N) - 3 U(2N) + 2 U(4N).
```

For `A+C/N`, `R_q2=0` exactly.

For `A+B log N`,

```text
R_q2 = B log 2.
```

Using the post-reveal PR #142 Jordan discovery coefficient `B=0.368618338...` only as a power-planning value gives a nominal Jordan signal

```text
B log 2 ~= 0.25551.
```

This number is **not** a preregistered model target; the exact zero/nonzero algebra is the design target.

### Jordan-null

```text
R_J(N) = U(4N) - 2 U(2N) + U(N).
```

For `A+B log N`, `R_J=0` exactly.

For `A+C/N`,

```text
R_J = C/(4N).
```

The pair `(R_q2,R_J)` should be reported jointly with covariance.


1. It tests the exact composition `T_4 = T_2^2`, rather than combining two incommensurate scale factors.

4. H4 and H12 are both invariant under the net `pi/2` rotation, so this is intentionally a radial/Jordan test, not an angular discriminator.

Do **not** commit a large norm-4 run immediately.

1. Merge/validate PR #149 first.
2. Run a small disjoint-counter full-curve variance pilot on N260 and N340, analogous to PR #150.
3. Project the SE of `U` and the two linear residuals at 0.5B, 1B, 2B.
4. Compare expected q=2-vs-Jordan information per CPU-second against simply extending N325/N425 beyond 500M.
5. Promote norm 4 only if it materially improves expected discrimination cost, or if the arithmetic-class closure itself is considered worth the independent test.

The primary #57 H4/H12 production and its frozen chronology remain unchanged.

## Additional pure-field closure

The same data provide a secondary semigroup check for the robust central thermal row:

```text

```

under the pure x=21/4 H4 radial law, with no H4/H12 phase discrimination. This is useful as a cross-topology/radial consistency check but should not be counted as independent evidence from the same histograms without joint covariance.

Advance the dyadic closure only if:

- the general-period engine passes the existing exact geometry/oracle suite;
- source/target channel descriptors pass the canonical #146 semantics layer;
- the variance pilot shows useful power or the arithmetic-class test is explicitly justified;

issue.title: N100 production: shape splitting and zero-area thermal redistribution
issue.body:
## 最新：N400 新生产已完成，区分弱缺陷与真实宽化

追加提交：`3e01b49`（完整新数据）、`b892d9e6`（科学分析）。三形状各 800 万 shared-counter replicas，400 个对齐批次；共 2400 万组几何配对评估，但只有一个 800 万 counter 的 N400 依赖块。与 N100 独立，period 全部乘 2。采集前冻结 `894b3d8`。本机三进程约 363–429 秒完成，无新增云端作业。

- 共同有限 A/E 密度坐标主约束：N100 的 χ²=53.914/6，在新 N400 为 **3.901/6，p=.690**。这表示当前精度不再识别该缺陷，不表示坐标模型恢复或证明成立。
- 固定 p 的 free-common-secant 为 1.558/3；完整六矩的跨尺度 raw amplitude 约 −.0303，95% profile 区间 [−.2068,.1835]，不能宣称符号反转。
- **正面新观察是完整 odd clock 的宽化**：D_A 的归一化中心二阶矩，在声明的 z=N^(3/8)(p−p_ref) 中由 1.440±.0156 增至 2.123±.0738；|z|≤2 的 signed-area fraction 从 .9527±.000875 降至 .8682±.00615。这不是另一个 p 值投票，而是实际热形状的尺度变化。
- 全 p 与中心窗结果、完整协方差、raw threshold histograms 都已保存。窗口宽度为采集后描述选择；两尺寸不决定渐近指数；ordinary scalar 无 Jacobian 模型另行分析。

主说明：[N400 尺度分析](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/b892d9e6/notes/etop-n400-scale-separation.md)。新目录：`results/etop-n400-three-modulus/`、`results/etop-n400-finite-transport-invariants/`、`results/etop-n100-n400-scale-transport/`。

追加机制结果：root说明已更新至`31255aad`，承接[fb1a944e去平滑分解](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/fb1a944e1ef34e9b9dfcf32c59af25f44ce43d9a)。去掉canonical binomial readout后，**96.895%±.507个百分点的宽化仍留在rank-clock轮廓本身**。两尺寸选后的有效宽度γ=.23796±.01352提示N^(-1/4)作为working fingerprint，未宣称新critical exponent。N900两项条件预测及共享锚点协方差已存，尚未启动该尺度采集。

以下保留此前 N100 发现记录，不把其显著性直接外推到 N400。

---

## 新结果：积分时钟相容，但热方向发生了重分布

这轮直接完成了新生产与分析，不是新增准备工具：N100 的 2i、4i、1/2+i 三个模形状各 200 万组配对计算（共 600 万组几何配对评估；三者共用 200 万个 permutation counters）。保留 200 个对齐批次、完整 12×12 协方差、原始 threshold histograms 和运行回执。三个本机单线程进程约20–29秒完成，无新远程作业。

### 科学变化

- 冻结的共同 affine-E4 模形状关系：chi²=58.26869/4，p=6.70e-12。
- 把共同形状坐标完全放开，仍有 chi²=19.21808/3，p=2.46e-4。这排除的是这三个有限几何上的共同标量仿射形状类，不是只把E4改排第二，也不是连续场计数。
- C 单独的 E4 残差只有 −0.467 SE。以 C 作为形状坐标后，奇通道残差严格满足 `∫R_A(p)dp=0`，但新流解析积分给出 `∫z R_A=-0.0002936353±0.000046967`（约6.25 SE），`∫z²R_A=0.0008485571±0.00010592`。
- 奇曲线正负面积约 ±0.000347135。最大平均波瓣在 p≈0.32125，而非临界参考点；因此新的工作解释是有限几何的热方向重分布，不能直接叫作已识别临界场。

精确关系是 `∫P4[A_top]=-2C`、`∫P4[E_top]=-W`。它把“C可兼容E4”与“完整A/E/C/W形状不相容”放在同一个机制描述中。

### 产物与范围

- `notes/etop-clock-redistribution-n100.md`：推导、结果、科学卡及下一判别量。
- `results/etop-n100-three-modulus/`：全新生产、固定主检验、比较模型和来源不确定性迁移。
- `results/etop-thermal-redistribution/`：全部热矩和p曲线紧凑网格的完整协方差，零额外MC。
- 三模实验冻结于4c1ec50，采集runner为295ac79，结果为7b30648；精确三模关系承接964d770。

固定主检验是采集前冻结的；clock quotient、全p矩和自由secant是明确标记的采集后探索。所有目标读出重用同一依赖块，不合并p值、不声称独立复现。未重跑全库测试，未合并/关闭/重排任何任务。

下一步优先区分“临界窗内重分布”与“全p/细长几何效应”，不继续把算力花在相同标量谐波的重复投票上。

- 尚需的是明确 law-preserving 周期构造/概率比较或可区分的新机制，而非再做同一代数/11候选筛查。#438 的 W5周期对象已建成，但既有 balance roots、port reversal 与图编码均不构成阈值公式或严格界。
- 已补读 2026-08-31 新认领的 Green 关系、最小生成元、自同构、中心与子幺半群五类普查：它们仍可并行，但本线优先产出既有具体图律的比较或明确障碍；不取消、锁定这些任务，也不把普查完成作为概率分析先修。
- 当前总览与下一步见 Draft #267 的[上下文恢复](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md)与[注意力顺序](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/NEXT-TARGETS.md)；原提案全文保留在下。

---

## Conjecture

A sequence of exactly solvable decorated cells can approximate the four-terminal connectivity law induced by a square-lattice occupied site and generate exact algebraic thresholds converging rapidly to the square-site threshold.

## Search space

- Planar three- and four-terminal cells with bounded internal vertices/edges.
- Site, bond, and correlated-bond representations with exact terminal partition probabilities.
- Cells equivalent under graph isomorphism, terminal permutation, series/parallel reduction, and obvious dualities are canonicalized once.
- Retain only constructions that tile periodically and admit a self-dual or otherwise exact critical condition.

## Scoring

- Distance of the exact threshold to the current numerical interval.
- Prediction error on another observable or related lattice.
- Convergence rate with cell complexity.
- Structural simplicity and proof transparency.

## Deliverables

- Canonical cell encoding and exhaustive enumeration bound.
- Exact terminal-connectivity polynomials.
- Self-duality/critical-manifold checker.
- Ranked candidate sequences with algebraic minimal polynomials.
- Negative-result certificate for the explored search space.

## Acceptance

A close decimal match alone is not a result. A retained family must be parameter-free, exactly derived, and predict convergence or another independent quantity.

## Resources

8 CPU cores / 16 GB for the first bounded search. GPU is optional for batched evaluation; high-memory CPU may later be more useful.

Tracked as `T09` in `experiments/tasks.yaml`.

issue.title: [P0 exact/process] Trace-equivalent is not a Markov state: a full-survival counterexample and branching-aware continuation algebra
issue.body:
## Scientific output update — 2026-08-31 second continuation

Open PR #491 / ab90201 已提交[occupied-cut机制](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/ab90201e88409310632812727e0138c56b455644/notes/p487-cut-network-theorem.md)。在所述embedded rank-one torus范围，切occupied essential cycle后，rank2 continuation等价于两端点vertex connectivity；保留初始cut并activate/contract得到update-closed网络。

两旧N425检查点的边来自neutral-component bicliques，W2差540=472+68，c3=583/509；这是既有选定样本的几何解释，不是新人口H4证据。下一项是cut-invariant/covariant component-incidence/overlap的paired population响应，或较长时距vertex reliability。不重复firstcut、图重建或已解释的W2碰撞。交叉matching图、退化商图、最小/有界状态与场识别不由此自动覆盖。

<details>
<summary>Previous body preserved — historical context</summary>

## Read against the updated frontier

This starts after main `c64bfabde8c8bb13290d4f5d8e5f44c1779d4d30`, #403's killed survival certificate, and #401 / PR #415 (`d09f925`) including the three-step overlap counterexample. It does **not** propose another `c2,c3,...` counter. The full survival vector has already been identified as sufficient for the remaining **unmarked rank trace at a fixed checkpoint**. The question here is different: does that vector, recomputed on the actual configuration after each insertion, itself define an autonomous Markov state?

**New exact answer: no, already on the square N16 control.** All unbranched future rank distributions can agree while the next predictive-state distribution differs. This is the trace-equivalence / probabilistic-bisimulation distinction made concrete in the existing percolation observable.

## 1. Equal complete survival law, different branching law

Use the honest square torus `P=diag(4,4)`, with physical site coordinates `(x,y)` modulo four. Define

```
A={(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(1,1),(3,1),(0,3),(1,3)},
B={(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1),(3,1),(0,3)}.
```

These are row-major masks 12463 and 4343 under `label=x+4*y`; the coordinate sets, not the masks, specify the witness.

Both have `k=8`, ambient rank one and primitive line `(1,0)`. For

```
b_m(S)=#{U subset vacant(S): |U|=m, r(S union U)=1},
s_m(S)=b_m(S)/C(8,m),
```

their **entire** count vector is identical:

```
b=(1,7,18,20,8,0,0,0,0),
s=(1,7/8,9/14,5/14,4/35,0,0,0,0).
```

Consequently every future event depending only on the unmarked rank trajectory has the same probability at A and B. This is not a finite-horizon truncation failure.

Now perform a different, operationally explicit experiment:

1. make one ordinary, uniformly random vacant insertion, obtaining S';
2. clone S' into two independent futures;
3. make one uniformly random vacant insertion in each clone;
4. ask whether **both** clones remain rank one. If the common insertion already reaches rank two, score zero.

Write `x(S')` for the existing one-site exit count. Among the eight possible common insertions the exact distributions are:

| initial state | already absorbed | safe, x'=1 | safe, x'=2 | safe, x'=3 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 1 | 3 | 2 | 2 |
| B | 1 | 1 | 6 | 0 |

There are seven vacancies at S', so

```
B_11(A)=[3*6^2+2*5^2+2*4^2]/(8*7^2)=95/196,
B_11(B)=[1*6^2+6*5^2]/(8*7^2)=93/196,
B_11(A)-B_11(B)=1/98.
```

Direct enumeration gives 190 versus 186 successful branch choices out of 392. Their unbranched two-step survival is still exactly 9/14 in both cases.

Cloning immediately at the original checkpoint would **not** detect this: its success probability is a product of the already equal `s_m`. The shared update before branching is essential.

## 2. This also fails under the actual uniform-permutation law

The preceding pair disproves strong lumpability. A separate selected-prefix enumeration establishes a history-dependent transition under the actual sampling law, not just an adversarial mixture of starting states.

At k=8, condition on rank one, line `(1,0)` and the complete count vector above. This stratum contains 192 current subsets and 7,741,440 ordered length-eight prefixes. Let E be the event that the next state remains rank one and has `x(S_9)=3`. Then

| K1 | ordered prefixes | P(E given the full current signature and K1) |
|---|---:|---:|
| 4 | 110,592 | 1/6 |
| 5 | 442,368 | 1/6 |
| 6 | 1,198,080 | 2/13 |
| 7 | 2,442,240 | 8/53 |
| 8 | 3,548,160 | 2/11 |

In particular `2/11-1/6=1/66`. The first birth K1 is measurable from the past rank records. E is measurable from the next full survival signature. Thus the process of **recomputed microscopic survival signatures** is not Markov under the uniform-permutation law.

Independent checks already executed locally: the inherited integer-lift BFS and a separately written row-major potential-union-find agree on rank and primitive line for all 65,536 N16 configurations. Integer prefix DP agrees with exhaustive permutation enumeration of all 7,741,440 prefixes **in the selected stratum**, not all 16P8 prefixes. Subset enumeration independently checks the witness's complete survival counts and the branch probabilities. The reproducible certificate will accompany this issue as an additive commit.

## 3. Exact bounded state-refinement census

For each tested quotient, group rank-one states by `(k,line,complete b-vector)`. Separately compute the coarsest strong Markov partition preserving k and line by backward refinement of the distributions over successor classes, with rank-two configurations collapsed to one absorbing cemetery state.

| quotient | rank-one configurations | full-survival classes | strong Markov classes | split survival classes |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2+i, N5 | 10 | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| 3, N9 | 162 | 10 | 10 | 0 |
| 3+i, N10 | 310 | 16 | 16 | 0 |
| 3+2i, N13 | 2,340 | 62 | 62 | 0 |
| 4, N16 | 19,932 | 210 | 214 | 4 |
| 4+i, N17 | 38,896 | 346 | 390 | 42 |

Counts exclude the common cemetery state. This is **only this six-quotient census**, not an all-HNF minimality theorem. No asymptotic rank-growth conclusion follows from it.

## 4. The correct autonomous object is an observable algebra, not only a linear row space

Include a cemetery state so the transition operator P is stochastic. Begin with the rank/k/line observation functions. On a finite state space, a partition is strongly lumpable precisely when its block-constant function algebra is invariant under P.

This gives a constructive target:

```
A_pred = smallest unital pointwise algebra containing the declared observations
         and invariant under P.
```

Why an algebra? A linear span of `P^m 1_alive` predicts single traces, but it need not contain nonlinear functions of successor predictions. Independent future forks introduce pointwise products. An ordinary transition introduces P. Alternating these operations generates a branching-sensitive test language.

For a family of future survival functions f_i at the successor layer, the matrix

```
Gamma_ij(S)=P(f_i f_j)(S)-P f_i(S)*P f_j(S)
```

is exactly the covariance matrix of successor predictions and hence positive semidefinite. In the witness, the relevant means coincide while `P(f_1^2)` differs by 1/98.

This is an application of finite probabilistic state minimization, **not a new abstract bisimulation theorem**. Nor should this pointwise function algebra be identified with #398's Q-adic or Hankel multiplication algebra: a finite real function algebra is reduced; it does not by itself manufacture a physical nilpotent or an LCFT module.

## 5. Preserve the useful weaker model

The full survival vector remains exactly sufficient for its original rank-only future language. A belief state conditioned only on continued survival can update by shifting and normalizing the survival curve. That filtered belief is not the same object as recomputing the signature of the actual, unobserved microscopic successor.

Similarly, the process-Hankel suggestion in #401 is valid for its declared future language. The new result does not refute minimal linear realization there. It shows that branching, intermediate state readout or interventions require a larger language and potentially a different state quotient.

If the scientific objective is only to estimate remaining lifetime, no branching-aware enlargement is necessary. It becomes necessary when claiming an autonomous coarse process or composing state-conditioned operations.

## 6. Next experiment: branch after a common, scaled continuation

Reuse the current-state snapshot/pilot machinery, without changing its frozen primary score. Freeze a small set of shared-prefix lengths a and subsequent horizons m,n. For layered killed kernels, measure

```
B_(a;m,n)(S)=P_k ... P_(k+a-1)[s_m s_n](S),
```

with survival functions evaluated at the correct successor layer. At a=0 this reduces to the existing independent-future product; a>0 probes missing update structure.

At larger N, choose both shared and branch horizons on a declared near-critical scale. `N^(5/8)` is a conditional square-site candidate, not a theorem here; an independently calibrated intrinsic/pivotal clock is preferable when available. Keep the early checkpoint, shared continuation and cloned futures as nested clusters in covariance estimation. Do not treat clones as independent initial configurations.

An exact tiny verifier should return a smallest distinguishing branching test when a proposed state quotient fails. For approximate closure, compare successor laws with an explicitly chosen total-variation or behavioural-distance tolerance and propagate error over the frozen horizon. Small mean residuals or a low Hankel rank alone are not such a guarantee.

**Risky hypothesis:** a compact geometry-aware state may predict both traces and branching laws after rescaling even though the raw full-survival signature does not. The alternative is sharper than another age coefficient: the branching-sensitive state complexity grows, so an autonomous low-dimensional description is the wrong target even when single-trace prediction stays cheap.

## 7. arXiv connections checked

- Turkenburg, Beohar, van Breugel, Kupke, Rot, [2504.08639v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.08639), revised 13 October 2025: constructive witnesses for lower bounds on behavioural distances. This motivates returning a distinguishing experiment rather than only reporting a failed rank or residual.
- Spork, Baier, Katoen, Klueppelholz, Piribauer, [2505.15587v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15587): approximate CTMC bisimulation separates transition-probability error from clock-rate error and bounds timed reachability. Our process is layered discrete growth; their CTMC bounds cannot be imported without the clock/model map.
- Chen, Clerc, Panangaden, [2511.21621](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21621): transition-based versus path-based behavioural pseudometrics. These are useful distinct validation targets, not a percolation result.
- Garban, Pete, Schramm, [1305.5526](https://arxiv.org/abs/1305.5526): near-critical percolation is constructed on a full geometric state space. It does not imply a finite rank/line/reliability compression is Markov.
- Widder, Zimmer, Schilling, [2503.20457](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20457): projection-induced memory and the full dynamics must be distinguished. The finite counterexample here is direct, with no GLE approximation.
- Alves, Baldasso, Moreira, Teixeira, [2606.11503](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.11503), submitted 9 June 2026: hierarchical percolation offers a separately defined recursive control for state compression and scaling. Its graph-replacement theorems are not square-site universality results.

Related: #401, #403, #249, #370, #398, #400, #419. Exact finite results and a proposed acquisition only; no new Monte Carlo production, continuum-memory law, physical field identification or repository-wide CI claim.

</details>

已完成[统一单位后的实际档案重分析](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/e2b57aa7c5ec5c7db8cbb4f03872435f20966407/results/p418-normalized-archive/REPORT.md)，在原 Draft #267 中保留旧结果与时间线，不覆盖原数据。

独立读码确认 old4 的每batch200与r5/r6的3000都保存 sums；原共同reader未除samples。新分析只统一为per-sample，沿用原geometry/CRT mask、协方差截断、非负谱族、250次参数bootstrap和alpha=.01。

在该继承约定下，四个共同masked距离约70.878/75.692/76.766/68.067，p约.382/.183/.175/.367。共同拟合的已存正权重达到rank69线性最小二乘下界（差<7e−11），旧584–1153的大距离及其radius-flow解释不再得到这个正确单位分数支持。另发现r5单壳退化NNLS的浮点近零空间泄漏；其单壳分数及依赖它的sharing penalty标为numerically_unreliable，只保留追溯，不用来宣称通过/拒绝机制。共同拟合含old4 zero-lag，诊断稳定；不将数值问题扩展为全部P250失效。

非拒绝不是唯一谱/场识别，raw与masked此处等距不是两个锥普遍等价（old4含zero-lag）。独立P250已正确归一的状态/秩结果、精确CRT/root-translation和paired-anchor自身统计保留。下一步应面向真正可区分的谱预测/读出，不能重跑旧anchor解释一个已消失的惩罚。

<details>
<summary>Previous body preserved — historical context</summary>

## Relation to the current frontier

This continues #406 after its completed positive-Fourier-cone archive result `dbeb29c`, and after `33c557b -> 93eaab1`. The four raw cones survive. The next proposal is a **more structured, still convex forward model**, derived from the actual fiber section and C4 gauge. It neither reopens the old R2 vote nor replaces a frozen result.

Pinned code semantics: `33c557b9aebed1bc9c07019b9cd5cee6c04be947`, especially `integer_period_torus.py`, `z5_projective_leg_cross_scale_mc.py`, `z5_projective_leg_bivariate_mc.py`, and the /5, negative-sign DFT in `z5_charged_threepoint_mc.py`.

## Exact observation: a unique homomorphic section

Let E be either child translation group (order 505), H the parent translation group (order 101), and K the deck kernel (order 5). In

`0 -> K -> E -> H -> 0`,

101 and 5 are coprime. Define

`s_CRT(x) = 405 * x_tilde in E`,

using any lift x_tilde of x. This is well defined because 405 annihilates K; it is a section because 405=1 mod101; it is a homomorphism. It is unique since Hom(H,K)=0. Scalar multiplication commutes with rotation, so the section respects the Gaussian C4 action as well.

Thus rotation covariance and translation covariance can hold simultaneously. The runner's orbitwise C4 gauge leaves a residual site-phase freedom; the CRT section removes it canonically for this coprime cover.

For the stored BFS section s(x), define b_h(x) in Z/5 by

`s_CRT(x) = s(x) + b_h(x)*(10,1) mod child_periods`.

Let t_h(x) be the existing `rotation_gauges()` value. The actual DFT convention gives

`F_CRT,h,r(x) = zeta^(r b_h(x)) F_raw,h,r(x)`,

`F_stored,h,r(x) = m_h,r(x) F_CRT,h,r(x)`,

`m_h,r(x) = zeta^(r [t_h(x)-b_h(x)])`.

The sign is fixed by the negative-sign DFT, not fitted.

## Exact factorization of the ensemble target

For the iid Bernoulli child ensemble and the translation-covariant real rank-one root field used by P250, the homomorphic section implies

`E[F_CRT(x) conj(F_CRT(y))] = C_CRT(y-x)`.

Uniformly averaging the anchor over H therefore gives

`G_stored(d) = A_h,r(d) C_CRT,h,r(d)`,

`A_h,r(d) = (1/101) sum_x m_h,r(x) conj(m_h,r(x+d))`.

A is deterministic and fully known. This is an ensemble identity, not a configurationwise identity for a one-random-anchor batch. Old finite-sample means do not become exact by dividing. Preserve their complete covariance and sampling convention. The runner's `%101` anchor selection approximates the intended uniform law; formal exactness should include its elementary finite-64-bit modulo-bias bound, not silently change the runner.

The corresponding Fourier spectra satisfy the known circular convolution

`w_stored = w_CRT * a_mask`,

with both factors nonnegative. An arbitrary positive Fourier completion is therefore weaker than this physical stationary-section model.

## No exact zeros, but substantial conditioning effects

Every mask value is

`A(d) = [c0+c1*zeta+c2*zeta^2+c3*zeta^3+c4*zeta^4]/101`,

where the nonnegative integer counts sum to 101. A(d)=0 would require all five counts equal, by the minimal polynomial `1+zeta+...+zeta^4`; this is impossible because 5 does not divide 101.

Algebraic de-gauging is thus invertible at every displacement. Statistical conditioning is a separate matter.

I independently reconstructed the pinned BFS representatives, child congruences, orbitwise C4 gauge and CRT lift. In the cyclic coordinate j(a,b)=a-10b mod101, the following attenuation witnesses result:

| hand | charge | residue j(d) | counts c0..c4 | exact squared magnitude | approximate magnitude |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---:|
| plus | 1 | 27 | (9,30,14,20,28) | (401-178 sqrt(5))/10201 | 0.01709147 |
| plus | 2 | 33 | (9,30,14,20,28) | (401-178 sqrt(5))/10201 | 0.01709147 |
| minus | 1 | 14 | (28,8,24,15,26) | (356-75 sqrt(5))/10201 | 0.13586197 |
| minus | 2 | 39 | (28,8,24,15,26) | (356-75 sqrt(5))/10201 | 0.13586197 |

These are exact count-derived examples, not a certified global-minimum claim. Dividing the plus examples amplifies standard errors by about 58.51. The residual-phase counts are (21,20,20,20,20) in both hands, with phases ordered 0..4.

This is deterministic geometry work, not new Monte Carlo evidence. Neither the complete repository suite nor an archived-data de-gauging score was run in this contribution.

## Archive-first task: fit forward, rather than divide unstably

Use the existing old4/radius5/radius6 mean/covariance bundle and fit

`G_observed(d) = A_h,r(d) sum_k w_h,r(k) exp(-2*pi*i*k*j(d)/101)`,

`w_h,r(k) >= 0`.

Everything except the nonnegative weights is geometry-fixed. Realify the design and retain the same dependency-group covariance, aliases and singular-direction constraints. This is convex weighted least squares/cone feasibility, without arbitrary roots, a rank-eight premise, or generic SOS.

Fit in the original coordinates. Division is equivalent only with the full covariance transformation. Spectral completion may remain underdetermined; report feasible mass intervals and prediction envelopes rather than a unique spectrum or field count.

### Useful outputs

1. Exact section/gauge/mask artifact and an independent congruence verifier.
2. Compare the already-tested raw positive cone with the stricter mask-times-positive cone on the same evidence and uncertainty convention.
3. Identify which apparent spatial features are explained by the deterministic mask, and which remain after its exact forward model.
4. Derive uncertainty envelopes for genuinely new mesoscopic observables. An intervention-sensitive envelope requires a separately specified intervention model; it cannot be inferred from endpoint spectra alone.

A failure of the stricter model should first trigger inspection of section, sampling and observable-transport assumptions: the factorization follows from the stated finite ensemble's translation symmetry and is not a disposable phenomenological ansatz.

## Physical boundary and risky conjecture

Conjecture: a material part of the two hands' different low-order relation spaces is caused by different deterministic phase-mask convolutions, rather than different counts of physical states. This is not implied by the factorization alone and must be tested. A remaining difference after de-gauging is a better-typed quantity; it does not retroactively rescue the rejected raw R2 map.

**This is not a low-rank rescue.** The cyclotomic full-support obstruction in #406 remains relevant to the CRT field as well whenever its nonconstancy premises hold. Removing a phase mask need not produce a sparse exact spectrum, rank five, or rank eight. The goal is to separate known coordinate mixing from the observable's spatial spectrum.

Neither the section nor the positive spectrum identifies a continuum primary or excludes Jordan structure for a different transfer/dilation operator. Spatial translation, dilation, physical row transfer and projection-induced memory remain distinct.

## Literature and resources

- Yang, Xie, Stoica, arXiv:1505.02510, https://arxiv.org/abs/1505.02510: Toeplitz/Vandermonde reconstruction. Here the finite spectral support is known; no off-grid uniqueness premise is imported.
- Widder, Zimmer, Schilling, arXiv:2503.20457, https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20457: projected dynamics and memory are not the unprojected spatial symmetry.
- The CRT section and mask factorization above are direct finite-group derivations from the pinned geometry, not results attributed to these papers.

Small local exact work and an archived-data convex replay only. No server access, new production, history rewriting, or permissions layer. Related: #250, #400, #406, #249, #370.

- 当前总览与下一步见 Draft #267 的[上下文恢复](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md)与[注意力顺序](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/NEXT-TARGETS.md)；原提案全文保留在下。

---

## Trigger

Two late frontiers now look like different coordinate views of the same algebraic problem.

### Generic-Q / Gram side

The #333/#370 exact program has moved far beyond a generic “Jordan fit”:

- the join-only width-3/4 closure has an exact first-jet Gram/source obstruction;
- adding the ordinary scalar FK detach/loop weight does not open the missing radical direction;
- one genuine terminal mark has nonzero Q-velocity on the extended radical but is still insufficient;
- the minimum falling-factorial scalar-mark families tested at widths 3/4 remain incompatible with the first-jet Gram form, and the width-4 scalar family is exhausted.

So the unresolved object is not simply “one more scalar coordinate”. The obstruction lives in the degeneration structure of the bilinear form itself.

### Context-Hankel / charged side

The P250 endpoint-Hankel program has also crossed a qualitative boundary:

- within each hand, rank <= 5/6/7 is statistically eliminated in the frozen radius-6 block;
- rank 8 is only the first compatible truncated rank, not an exact or flat physical dimension;
- the old Alexander-R2 degree-two null line does not extend to equality of the complete degree-three rank-eight kernel planes;
- endpoint data still do not determine ordered `T_x T_y` versus `T_y T_x` structure.

PR #385 adds the identifiability warning: an ordinary diagonalizable family can approach a Jordan semigroup arbitrarily closely at finite noise. Therefore “more precise eigenvalue fitting” cannot by itself separate reduced ordinary states from a confluent/non-semisimple limit.

I think the natural next object is **scheme-theoretic rather than spectral**.

## Literature collision

Two recent algebraic developments are unusually close to what the repository is already computing.

1. **Martin--Senécal--Spencer, arXiv:2601.17445** (`Cell modules for the Temperley-Lieb algebra in mixed characteristic`) completely describe TL cell-module submodule structure and explicitly investigate two-dimensional **Jantzen-like filtrations**.

2. **Hernández Caro--Ryom-Hansen, arXiv:2210.03847** diagonalize cell-module bilinear forms in a TL/blob/Soergel setting and use their vanishing structure to construct Jantzen-type filtrations and a graded sum formula.

3. **Bernardi--Jelisiejew--Reig Fité, arXiv:2606.30600** prove that Hankel flat-extension completion is equivalent to completing the **multiplication tensor of an Artinian Gorenstein algebra**. Unknown moments and unknown multiplication-tensor coefficients are the same variables in two coordinate systems; the resulting multiplication matrices and commutation equations coincide.

4. **Ikhlef--Morin-Duchesne, arXiv:2312.14837** give a useful periodic-TL control where non-generic standard modules are reducible indecomposables with a radical and quotient, and relate their fusion to logarithmic bulk CFT connectivity operators.

These suggest replacing two ad hoc languages—“try another marked Q-direction” and “fit another Hankel root”—by canonical filtrations and finite algebras.

## Core proposal A — compute the Q-adic/Jantzen filtration instead of guessing marks

Let

```text
t = Q-1
```

and let `W` be one declared generic-Q connectivity/closure module over a local coefficient ring near `t=0`, with invariant bilinear form

```text
G(t) = G0 + t G1 + t^2 G2 + ... .
```

The current repository mostly studies `rad(G0)` and the first-jet compatibility equation. Instead define the higher vanishing filtration schematically by

```text
J^k = {
  v mod t : <v,W>_t is divisible by t^k
}.
```

The exact implementation need not assume a theorem from the papers. Compute it directly from the repository's polynomial Gram matrix.

A practical exact route is:

```text
1. construct G(t) symbolically to sufficient t-order;
2. compute Smith/invariant-factor data over Q[t] localized at (t),
   or an equivalent exact t-adic elimination;
3. record the valuations a_i in elementary divisors t^(a_i);
4. recover dim J^k/J^(k+1) and canonical basis representatives;
5. act with join, detach, translation/seam and declared marked morphisms on the associated graded pieces.
```

This is a stronger object than `rank(G0)` or one first derivative. It answers **how many independent confluent directions the degenerating form actually supplies, at which Q-order, and in which representation sector**.

### Immediate use on the current negative results

Project the already-tested scalar/falling-factorial marks into the canonical layers

```text
J^1/J^2,
J^2/J^3,
...
```

instead of asking whether an arbitrary finite list closes the first-jet equation.

My guess is that the scalar marks fail because they do not span the first required associated-graded representation. If the missing layer is intrinsically rooted/connectivity-valued, the filtration should show this before another mark family is invented.

## Core proposal B — interpret P250 flat extension as a finite algebra, not “r states”

Let the mixed-displacement endpoint moments define a truncated functional `L` and Hankel matrix `H_d`.

If a rank-`r` flat extension exists, the Bernardi--Jelisiejew--Reig Fité result says the correct reconstructed object is a finite quotient algebra schematically

```text
A = C[x,y]/I,
dim A = r,
```

with multiplication operators

```text
M_x, M_y : A -> A.
```

The important distinction is then not merely

```text
rank = 8 or rank = 9?
```

but

```text
reduced finite scheme       <-> distinct ordinary support states,
nonreduced local components <-> multiplicity / nilpotent directions,
                              hence confluent/Jordan-like memory.
```

This is exactly the distinction that finite-noise eigenvalue fits cannot robustly resolve in PR #385.

### Concrete P250 analysis

Using the locked radius-6 moments, separately for plus and minus hands:

1. attempt the next-degree flat extension without imposing the rejected full R2 kernel-plane equality;
2. if compatible, reconstruct the annihilator ideal / multiplication tensor in a basis selected by invariant Hankel structure rather than fitted exponential roots;
3. compute Hilbert function, multiplication minimal polynomials, nilradical dimension, and Jordan type of generic linear combinations `a M_x+b M_y`;
4. distinguish “eight reduced points” from schemes with multiplicity only when the exact/structural information supports that distinction;
5. treat the upcoming ordered connected two-morphism rectangle as an extension beyond this **commutative endpoint shadow**: it asks whether the physical category action factors through the reconstructed commutative algebra or needs ordered/path memory.

If flatness fails at rank 8, that is itself cleaner than adding another pole: rank 8 was only a truncated Hilbert-function lower bound, not a realizable finite algebra.

## Core proposal C — compare invariants across the two constructions

Do **not** identify the P333 Q-adic module and the P250 spatial moment algebra merely because both contain nilpotents.

Instead compare invariant summaries:

```text
Q-adic side:
  Jantzen-layer dimensions,
  radical/Loewy length,
  representation characters,
  nilpotent action on associated graded pieces;

Hankel side:
  Hilbert function,
  reduced/nonreduced support type,
  nilradical dimension,
  Jordan type of multiplication operators,
  sector/deck/C4 action on the finite algebra.
```

A genuine common mechanism should reproduce more than one scalar log coefficient: it should give compatible **extension geometry** in parameter space and context space.

## Strong conjecture

> The minimal predictive object in Matching One is not a list of continuum fields/eigenvalues. It is a finite (possibly nonreduced) operator-state scheme together with typed module actions. Jordan behaviour is then local nilpotent geometry of this scheme, while ordinary multiple fields are its reduced support.

In this picture:

```text
P333 Q->1 degeneration
    = tangent/Jantzen geometry of the module family;

P250 finite Hankel realization
    = coordinate algebra of the observable/context scheme;

PR #385 near-coalescing ambiguity
    = reduced points approaching a nonreduced point in the same closure;

PR #393 common-nilpotent semigroup
    = one very small formal local-algebra model, not yet the full scheme.
```

This also explains why increasing a scalar state count can be the wrong reaction to every failed closure: the new information may be a multiplicity/extension coordinate, not a new reduced point.

## First exact controls

### 1. TL cell-module control

On a tiny Temperley--Lieb module where the radical/submodule structure is already known, compute the same `t`-adic Gram filtration using repository-style exact arithmetic and compare with the known radical/quotient structure.

### 2. Synthetic Hankel controls

Construct exact moment tables for:

```text
A. r distinct reduced points;
B. one double point + r-2 reduced points;
C. a length-3 local algebra;
D. two near-coalescing but still reduced points.
```

Verify that the flat-extension/multiplication reconstruction separates A/B/C exactly while D approaches B continuously, reproducing the PR #385 identifiability boundary.

### 3. Current P333 width-3/4 data

Compute the Q-adic invariant factors before adding any further scalar marks. Compare the tested mark families with the canonical associated-graded layers.

### 4. Current P250 endpoint moments

Treat rank 8 as a candidate truncated algebra dimension, not a field count. Attempt flat/multiplication completion and publish the scheme invariants or the exact obstruction to such a completion.

## Boundaries

- The current connectivity module has not yet been proved to be the particular TL/blob cell module of the cited Jantzen literature. The literature motivates the invariant; the repository should compute its own filtration exactly.
- Artinian-Gorenstein/Hankel reconstruction applies only when the required flat-extension/moment hypotheses are satisfied. A statistical rank lower bound alone does not create such an algebra.
- At finite noise, reduced versus arbitrarily near-nonreduced alternatives remain nonseparable without structural constraints, exactly as PR #385 warns. Use exact controls and declared symmetry/algebra constraints for sharp claims.
- A nonreduced finite algebra is not by itself a Virasoro Jordan module or an LCFT field identification.
- Every derived coordinate from the same raw block remains one correlated evidence block.

## Why this may simplify the repository

This proposal potentially replaces two expanding search trees

```text
more Q-dependent marks,
more fitted spatial eigenmodes,
```

by two canonical algebraic constructions

```text
Q-adic radical/Jantzen filtration,
Hankel multiplication algebra / finite scheme.
```

The output is structural and proof-carrying: a filtration, an ideal, multiplication tables, radical dimensions and representation actions. Those objects survive basis changes and are much closer to the non-semisimple algebra that the current data are already forcing us to confront.

Related: #218, #249, #250, #333, #370, PR #382, PR #385, PR #393.

- 当前总览与下一步见 Draft #267 的[上下文恢复](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md)与[注意力顺序](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/NEXT-TARGETS.md)；原提案全文保留在下。

---

## Trigger

The repository has just changed the meaning of the threshold-rank archive.

The new exact filtration oracle and the committed L=8 reconstruction identify

```text
K_minus = first essential ambient-H1 birth,
K_plus  = second essential ambient-H1 birth,
```

and therefore

```text
P(r=0)=1-F_1,
P(r=1)=F_1-F_2,
P(r=2)=F_2,
M=F_1+F_2-1,
M'/2=(f_1+f_2)/2.
```

The historical archive already contains the birth times, but the reconstruction note explicitly records that it **does not retain** three marks:

```text
projective winding line ell during the rank-one plateau,
integral saturation index,
local marks at the birth sites.
```

I think the first missing mark, `ell`, is unusually valuable and should be promoted from metadata to an observable.

## Core idea

At the first essential birth, the image of ambient `H_1` jumps

```text
0 -> ell,
```

where `ell` is a primitive rank-one subgroup / unoriented projective line in

```text
H_1(T^2,Z) ~= Z^2.
```

This line is canonical at the instant of the first rank birth. It is not an arbitrary local landing-sector definition and it is not a learned latent coordinate.

For a period basis `(v1,v2)`, choose the primitive homology vector `(a,b)` for `ell` up to sign and map it to the physical torus direction

```text
w_ell = a v1 + b v2.
```

Because `ell` is unoriented, even-spin characters are well-defined. In particular define

```text
chi4(ell) = (w_ell/|w_ell|)^4.
```

Its real/imaginary parts are a canonical spin-4 analyzer of the **topological cycle that is actually born**.

The proposal is to measure the joint law

```text
(first birth time tau_1,
 projective line ell,
 first-birth site/local environment optionally,
 second birth time tau_2,
 saturation index optionally)
```

in one Newman--Ziff/threshold-rank stream.

## Why this is not #156 or #215

### Not ordinary primitive-sector tomography (#156)

#156 measures rank-one homology-sector probabilities at a fixed `p`/modulus and organizes them by torus automorphism characters.

This issue measures the **marked flux of the first essential birth along the filtration**. It asks which homology line is created when ambient topology first appears and at what threshold it appears.

### Not the local pivotal landing mark (#215)

#215 chooses a local four-arm landing-sector H4 mark around pivotal sites.

Here the angular mark is supplied by the global topological event itself:

```text
which primitive ambient cycle was born?
```

It is therefore a direct microscopic coordinate for the exact observable `r`, with no proxy wrapping event or arbitrary annulus-sector registry.

## Marked birth densities

Let `tau_1` be the continuous priority at the first essential birth. Define the complex marked density

```text
j_4^(1)(p)
 = E[ delta(p-tau_1) chi4(ell_1) ].
```

The unmarked first-birth density is

```text
j_0^(1)(p)=f_1(p).
```

Also retain the plateau character

```text
A_4(p)
 = E[ 1[tau_1 <= p < tau_2] chi4(ell_1) ].
```

which is the spin-4 character of the unique ambient rank-one phase.

At the second birth, do not invent a canonical second direction if the subgroup data do not provide one. Retain the exact integral saturation/HNF mark separately. A later quotient-valued character can be derived only after its transformation law is proved.

## Central scientific question

The global Matching-One signal says that the **unlabelled** homology balance has a strong square-lattice H4 correction. This new observable asks where that anisotropy lives:

```text
birth timing?
which primitive cycle is born?
rank-one lifetime?
second-birth saturation arithmetic?
```

Those mechanisms are indistinguishable after reducing every sample to `(K_minus,K_plus)`.

## Three sharp mechanism classes

### H_timing — scalar timing anisotropy

The H4 signal changes the distribution of `tau_1,tau_2`, but conditional on being rank one the projective line distribution is asymptotically continuum-isotropic after the known torus-shape baseline is removed.

Prediction:

```text
unlabelled M / birth-time H4 nonzero,
marked chi4 birth-line signal subleading or zero.
```

### H_topological-Q4 — anisotropic essential-cycle nucleation

The same singlet spin-4 correction that violates the continuum homology identity biases which ambient cycle is created.

Prediction:

```text
j_4^(1) and/or A_4 has a stable spin-4 phase,
its Gaussian-cover transport is compatible with the global Q4/H4 representation,
modulus dependence follows the same allowed singlet shape after the appropriate continuum rank-one baseline is removed.
```

Do not assume the radial exponent before deriving the normalization of the marked density.

### H_charged-four-leg — the mark exposes the lower x=17/4 sector

The unlabelled scalar is Potts-singlet and may project out `V_(2,+/-2)_[2]`, while a homology-line-resolved/marked birth observable can carry additional representation data.

A risky but highly informative possibility is:

```text
unlabelled global M  -> first visible spin4 x=21/4 singlet,
marked birth-line flux -> substantial x=17/4 four-leg component.
```

This would realize the local/global split of #257 in a topology-defined observable, without relying on the current pivotal landing mark.

## Phase A — exact tiny oracle

Extend the existing essential-birth enumerator, not the production engine first.

For every permutation on the smallest supported square tori record:

```text
K1,K2,
ell_1 as a primitive projective vector,
rank/subgroup after each birth,
saturation index at K2,
site added at each birth.
```

Assert:

1. `ell_1` is invariant under choice of cycle representative up to sign;
2. unimodular changes of period basis transform it covariantly;
3. D4 lattice automorphisms give the declared action on `chi4`;
4. complement/Alexander reflection maps the birth data consistently;
5. summing over `ell_1` reproduces the existing unmarked `K_minus` histogram exactly.

- 共同有限 A/E 密度坐标主约束：N100 的 χ²=53.914/6，在新 N400 为 **3.901/6，p=.690**。这表示当前精度不再识别该缺陷，不表示坐标模型恢复或证明成立。
- 固定 p 的 free-common-secant 为 1.558/3；完整六矩的跨尺度 raw amplitude 约 −.0303，95% profile 区间 [−.2068,.1835]，不能宣称符号反转。
- **正面新观察是完整 odd clock 的宽化**：D_A 的归一化中心二阶矩，在声明的 z=N^(3/8)(p−p_ref) 中由 1.440±.0156 增至 2.123±.0738；|z|≤2 的 signed-area fraction 从 .9527±.000875 降至 .8682±.00615。这不是另一个 p 值投票，而是实际热形状的尺度变化。
- 全 p 与中心窗结果、完整协方差、raw threshold histograms 都已保存。窗口宽度为采集后描述选择；两尺寸不决定渐近指数；ordinary scalar 无 Jacobian 模型另行分析。

主说明：[N400 尺度分析](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/b892d9e6/notes/etop-n400-scale-separation.md)。新目录：`results/etop-n400-three-modulus/`、`results/etop-n400-finite-transport-invariants/`、`results/etop-n100-n400-scale-transport/`。

追加机制结果：root说明已更新至`31255aad`，承接[fb1a944e去平滑分解](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/fb1a944e1ef34e9b9dfcf32c59af25f44ce43d9a)。去掉canonical binomial readout后，**96.895%±.507个百分点的宽化仍留在rank-clock轮廓本身**。两尺寸选后的有效宽度γ=.23796±.01352提示N^(-1/4)作为working fingerprint，未宣称新critical exponent。N900两项条件预测及共享锚点协方差已存，尚未启动该尺度采集。

以下保留此前 N100 发现记录，不把其显著性直接外推到 N400。

---

## 新结果：积分时钟相容，但热方向发生了重分布

这轮直接完成了新生产与分析，不是新增准备工具：N100 的 2i、4i、1/2+i 三个模形状各 200 万组配对计算（共 600 万组几何配对评估；三者共用 200 万个 permutation counters）。保留 200 个对齐批次、完整 12×12 协方差、原始 threshold histograms 和运行回执。三个本机单线程进程约20–29秒完成，无新远程作业。

### 科学变化

- 冻结的共同 affine-E4 模形状关系：chi²=58.26869/4，p=6.70e-12。
- 把共同形状坐标完全放开，仍有 chi²=19.21808/3，p=2.46e-4。这排除的是这三个有限几何上的共同标量仿射形状类，不是只把E4改排第二，也不是连续场计数。
- C 单独的 E4 残差只有 −0.467 SE。以 C 作为形状坐标后，奇通道残差严格满足 `∫R_A(p)dp=0`，但新流解析积分给出 `∫z R_A=-0.0002936353±0.000046967`（约6.25 SE），`∫z²R_A=0.0008485571±0.00010592`。
- 奇曲线正负面积约 ±0.000347135。最大平均波瓣在 p≈0.32125，而非临界参考点；因此新的工作解释是有限几何的热方向重分布，不能直接叫作已识别临界场。

精确关系是 `∫P4[A_top]=-2C`、`∫P4[E_top]=-W`。它把“C可兼容E4”与“完整A/E/C/W形状不相容”放在同一个机制描述中。

### 产物与范围

- `notes/etop-clock-redistribution-n100.md`：推导、结果、科学卡及下一判别量。
- `results/etop-n100-three-modulus/`：全新生产、固定主检验、比较模型和来源不确定性迁移。
- `results/etop-thermal-redistribution/`：全部热矩和p曲线紧凑网格的完整协方差，零额外MC。
- 三模实验冻结于4c1ec50，采集runner为295ac79，结果为7b30648；精确三模关系承接964d770。

固定主检验是采集前冻结的；clock quotient、全p矩和自由secant是明确标记的采集后探索。所有目标读出重用同一依赖块，不合并p值、不声称独立复现。未重跑全库测试，未合并/关闭/重排任何任务。

下一步优先区分“临界窗内重分布”与“全p/细长几何效应”，不继续把算力花在相同标量谐波的重复投票上。

issue.body:
## 2026-08-31 上下文恢复（原提案保留在下）

- 终端状态/graph/corpus 与有序 gluing/serial 已完成：[`29f9716`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/29f9716) 的 port-aware D4 协变、[`4baa15a`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/4baa15a) 的15态有序 serial algebra（3375三元组结合，唯一 wire identity）可直接消费，不再列为缺失实现。
- [`52a61ff`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/52a61ff) 证明7个 D4 orbit 不是合法 serial quotient：49输入对有26个多值，均匀平均核在343三元组中166个不结合。**快照后新增** PR #465 / [`e300609`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/e300609) 已完成 port reversal 反对合，225乘积全成立、7固定点+4二循环；它不是 planar/complement dual。
- 真实有限 corpus 已筛过，而非只枚举：branch_only [`05514ba`](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/commit/05514ba) 对全部11个 connected 三终端单内点候选求精确 balance-root；最近者为可约路径0.61803399，没有得到新的 square-site 机制。
- 尚需的是明确 law-preserving 周期构造/概率比较或可区分的新机制，而非再做同一代数/11候选筛查。#438 的 W5周期对象已建成，但既有 balance roots、port reversal 与图编码均不构成阈值公式或严格界。
- 已补读 2026-08-31 新认领的 Green 关系、最小生成元、自同构、中心与子幺半群五类普查：它们仍可并行，但本线优先产出既有具体图律的比较或明确障碍；不取消、锁定这些任务，也不把普查完成作为概率分析先修。
- 当前总览与下一步见 Draft #267 的[上下文恢复](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/REPOSITORY-CONTEXT.md)与[注意力顺序](https://github.com/LightChainr/Matching-One/blob/research/navigation-priority-refresh-20260829/docs/NEXT-TARGETS.md)；原提案全文保留在下。

---

## Conjecture

A sequence of exactly solvable decorated cells can approximate the four-terminal connectivity law induced by a square-lattice occupied site and generate exact algebraic thresholds converging rapidly to the square-site threshold.

## Search space

- Planar three- and four-terminal cells with bounded internal vertices/edges.
- Site, bond, and correlated-bond representations with exact terminal partition probabilities.
- Cells equivalent under graph isomorphism, terminal permutation, series/parallel reduction, and obvious dualities are canonicalized once.
- Retain only constructions that tile periodically and admit a self-dual or otherwise exact critical condition.

## Scoring

- Distance of the exact threshold to the current numerical interval.
- Prediction error on another observable or related lattice.
- Convergence rate with cell complexity.
- Structural simplicity and proof transparency.

## Deliverables

- Canonical cell encoding and exhaustive enumeration bound.
- Exact terminal-connectivity polynomials.
- Self-duality/critical-manifold checker.
- Ranked candidate sequences with algebraic minimal polynomials.
- Negative-result certificate for the explored search space.

## Acceptance

A close decimal match alone is not a result. A retained family must be parameter-free, exactly derived, and predict convergence or another independent quantity.

## Resources

8 CPU cores / 16 GB for the first bounded search. GPU is optional for batched evaluation; high-memory CPU may later be more useful.

Tracked as `T09` in `experiments/tasks.yaml`.
