## Upgrade after the exact census: renormalize **boundary-connectivity laws**, not raw gadget graphs

The new exact layers have changed the natural search object. We now have canonical terminal partitions, canonical gadget graphs, a bounded connected census, complement orbits, bridge/articulation certificates, exact terminal-reliability polynomials for the whole bounded corpus, and finally an exact genus/planarity certificate. The next step should not be “enumerate one more internal vertex” by default.

Recent self-dual hypergraph work suggests a stronger route: treat a generator by its complete boundary-connectivity law and make **composition itself exact**.

Damavandi--Ziff, arXiv:1506.06125, formulate four-edge percolation in terms of the complete boundary partition probabilities; for a planar four-terminal generator with terminals in cyclic order, the crossing partition is forbidden, and the self-dual critical surface is given by paired equalities among the connectivity classes (their convention gives `P4=P1`, `P2=P3`, `P5=P6`). Bollobas--Riordan, arXiv:1001.4674, gives the broader self-dual polygon/hypergraph framework. Scullard--Jacobsen--Ziff, arXiv:2009.01913, is especially suggestive here: extraordinary accuracy on kagome-type hypergraphs can be explained by quantitative proximity to a known exact point/surface in connectivity space, not by a mysterious scalar-threshold coincidence.

### Phase 0 — strengthen “planar” to a boundary/disk embedding certificate

The current genus-zero certificate is necessary but not sufficient for a four-terminal hyperedge generator. Freeze a cyclic terminal order `(A,B,C,D)` and certify that all terminals lie on one face of a disk embedding in that order.

For such an embedding the `AC|BD` crossing connectivity must be impossible. This gives an immediate exact consistency check against the terminal-reliability corpus.

Archive separately:

```text
genus zero,

not disk-planar for that order.
```

Do not infer the second from the first.

### Phase 1 — exact gluing algebra on terminal partitions

Let a gadget signature be

```text
w_G(p) = ( P_G(pi;p) )_(pi in Part(T)),
```

using the already committed exact Bernstein/rational polynomials.

If two gadgets have independent internal edges and are glued by a frozen terminal-identification map, their boundary partitions combine by taking the join/transitive closure of the two equivalence relations and then restricting to the surviving boundary.

Therefore there is a geometry-independent integer tensor `C_glue` such that

```text
w_(G o H) = C_glue [ w_G tensor w_H ].
```

This should be proved by exhaustive tiny graph composition and then used as the primary implementation. It turns the terminal-partition space into a finite compositional algebra/category for the declared interfaces. I would avoid calling it the standard partition algebra until the exact multiplication/loop weights are matched, but the finite partition-state structure is already present.

The important payoff is computational: long decorated words can be explored in signature space without re-enumerating every internal bond configuration of the exponentially larger composite graph.

### Phase 2 — derive planar duality as an involution on the boundary law

For disk-planar generators, construct the dual action on noncrossing terminal partitions and verify known positive controls:

```text
3-terminal self-dual control: all-connected = all-disconnected
4-terminal control: reproduce the Damavandi--Ziff paired self-duality equations
```

Keep the full vector equation. Do not reduce to one scalar polynomial before the dual map is established.

A candidate exact critical point should satisfy

```text
D w(p*) = w(p*)
```

(or the appropriate paired primal/dual generator relation), with every component certified algebraically.

### Phase 3 — search compositions of the current corpus before enlarging the raw census

Use the existing connected/planar/non-vulnerable bounded candidates as generators and search short composition words in the exact boundary algebra.

For every word report:

```text
exact signature polynomial,
disk-embedding provenance,
duality residual vector,
physical roots in 0<p<1,
minimal polynomial / Sturm certificate,
word/canonical-equivalence class.
```

This is a much more structured search space than “all graphs with two more vertices”.

### Phase 4 — replace |p*-pc| by a **duality-defect vector** as the structural score

For the four-terminal convention define, before inspecting target roots,

```text
R_D(p) = (P4-P1, P2-P3, P5-P6)
```

(or the equivalent vector after our RGS convention is mapped exactly to the literature convention).

The central exploratory quantity should be the distance of the full connectivity law to the exact self-dual manifold, not only the decimal distance of one algebraic root to the numerical square-site `p_c`.

This yields a falsifiable conjecture:

> **Square-site may be unusually well approximated because its finite-cell boundary law lies close to a low-complexity exactly self-dual connectivity manifold, even if no bounded generator is exactly on that manifold.**

A close threshold with a large duality-defect vector is then much less interesting than a slightly worse threshold generated by a rapidly shrinking exact defect vector along a compositional family.

### Exact no-go output is valuable

For a frozen word-length / generator set, use the existing exact polynomial/root infrastructure to certify either:

```text
one physical self-dual solution exists,
```

or

```text
no p in (0,1) makes every duality equation vanish simultaneously.
```

The latter is a real negative theorem for the declared compositional envelope and tells us when enlarging the raw gadget class is justified.

### Relation to #14

Keep the claims separate. #13 asks for exact/self-dual critical constructions. #14 asks for rigorous stochastic comparison bounds. Once the boundary-signature/gluing map is exact, its monotone connectivity events can later feed #14's certified comparison layer, but a self-dual candidate is not automatically a domination theorem.

### Bold conjecture

The useful RG variable for this program may be the **terminal connectivity vector itself**. A gadget is then a finite boundary condition, gluing is an exact coarse-graining operation, and self-dual criticality is a fixed manifold of that operation. If this picture is right, the most interesting candidate family will be recognized by contraction toward that manifold in connectivity space before its scalar threshold looks spectacular.
